options.addongap: The gap between the main barcode and the add-on, in points. Default is 12.

options.append: The append option specifies that this symbol is an alphanumeric continuation symbol ("mode 1").
options.ast: Select an Application Specification Table profile. The default profile (default) provides the symbology's own specification values. Named profiles (e.g., gs1.sst1 through gs1.sst13) provide GS1-application-specific values.
options.backgroundcolor: Color of the light background or light modules.
options.badmod11: The badmod11 option allows a mod-11 checksum value of 10 to be encoded with a pair of check digits 10, with any checktype containing mod11. Normally any input whose checksum evaluates to 10 is considered invalid having no correct representation.
options.barcolor: Color of the bars or dark modules.

options.barxmult: The barxmult option specifies the height of each row in modules, at least 34. The default is 34.
options.borderbottom: Custom gap between the bottom edge of the symbol and the border or bearer bar, in points.
options.borderleft: Custom gap between the left edge of the symbol and the border or bearer bars, in points.
options.borderright: Custom gap between the right edge of the symbol and the border or bearer bars, in points.
options.bordertop: Custom gap between the top edge of the symbol and the border or bearer bar, in points.
options.borderwidth: Width of the border/bearers, in points.
options.c40headerlength: The c40headerlength option specifies the number of leading characters in the data field that must be stored using C40 encodation.

options.ccc: Deprecated: Internal use. The ccc option identifies this symbol as a CC-C 2D component of a GS1 Composite symbol.
options.cccolumns: The gs1-cc encoder draws the 2D component alone, and its cccolumns option sets the component's width in columns: 2 to 4 for CC-A and CC-B, and up to 30 for CC-C.

options.columns: The columns option specifies the number of columns (or groups of bars) in the output symbol, from 1 to 30.
options.compact: Deprecated: Use Compact PDF417 instead. The compact option is used to create a compact/truncated PDF417 symbol that has fewer bars per row than a standard symbol and hence is more narrow.
options.custinfoenc: Any remaining characters specify the customer information field, which FCCs 11, 45, 87 and 92 do not have. options.dmre: Deprecated: Consider Data Matrix Rectangular Extension. The dmre option enables Data Matrix Rectangular Extension symbols based on the ISO/IEC standard, which increases the number of rectangular symbol sizes available.
options.dontlint: Deprecated. The dontlint option disables GS1 Application Identifier syntax validation allowing images to be generated for input that does not comply with GS1 standards.
options.dotty: When the dotty option is specified the modules are rendered as dots rather than squares. The dot radius can be adjusted using the inkspread option.
options.ecaddchars: The ecaddchars option is used to specify how many additional error correction characters to add after applying the eclevel percentage, 3 or more, by default 3.
options.eclevel: The eclevel option is used to specify the percentage of error correction to be applied when expanding the data, from 5 to 95, by default 23.
options.extratextcolor: Color of the text for a given text group.
options.extratextdirection: The textNdirection option is used to specify in which direction to orient text for a given text group.
options.extratextfont: The PostScript font name for a text group.
options.extratextgaps: The inter-character spacing of a text group.
options.extratextlinegaps: Specify the gap between consecutive text lines for a text group.
options.extratextsize: The font size of a text group in points.
options.extratextsplit: Specify a character by which to split the text content into separate lines.
options.extratextsubspace: Specify a set of characters that will be replaced with spaces within the text content.
options.extratextxalign: The textNxalign option is used to specify where to horizontally position the text for a given text group.
options.extratextxoffset: The horizontal position of the text in points relative to the leftmost bar or modules.
options.extratextyalign: The textNyalign option is used to specify where to vertically position the text for a given text group.
options.extratextyoffset: The vertical position of the text in points relative to the base of the bars or modules.
options.fast: Deprecated. The fast option is used to enable the optional high-speed symbol masking algorithm.
options.fixedeclevel: The fixedeclevel option will prevent the error correction level from being opportunistically raised when a better fit to the current matrix is possible.
options.format: The format option is used to specify the shape of the symbol, either square (default) or rectangle.
options.griddpi: Specify the target resolution for grid-aligned module boundaries, in dots per inch. This can be useful if the target device's resolution cannot be probed.
options.gridfit: When enabled, the renderer adjusts the symbol scale so that module boundaries align to the device pixel grid, eliminating anti-aliasing artefacts.
options.guarddescent: The guarddescent option controls how far the guard bars extend below the data bars, in multiples of the X-dimension (default: 5).
options.guardheight: Height of the whitespace guards, in points.
options.guardleftpos: Override the default horizontal position of the left whitespace guard.
options.guardleftypos: Override the default vertical position of the left whitespace guard.
options.guardrightpos: Override the default horizontal position of the right whitespace guard.
options.guardrightypos: Override the default vertical position of the right whitespace guard.
options.guardwhitespace: The guardwhitespace option enables the display of whitespace guard marks.
options.guardwidth: Width of the whitespace guards, in points.
options.hdim: Directly specify the bar height in millimetres. Overrides the nominal height from the AST. Linear barcodes only.
options.height: Height of longest bar, in inches.
options.hidestars: The hidestars option suppresses the asterisks in the human readable text.
options.hnom: Override the nominal bar height in millimetres. Normally provided by the AST. Linear barcodes only.
options.includecheck: The includecheck option calculates the check digit.
options.includecheckintext: The includecheckintext option makes the calculated check digit appear in the human readable text.
options.includestartstop: The includestartstop option adds start and stop bars.
options.includetext: The includetext option should normally be supplied.
options.inkspread: The inkspread option can be used to adjust the width of the bars.
options.inkspreadh: For matrix barcodes, the amount by which to reduce the width of dark modules to compensate for inkspread, in points.
options.inkspreadv: For matrix barcodes, the amount by which to reduce the height of dark modules to compensate for inkspread, in points.
options.layers: The layers option is used to specify a particular number of layers in which to encode the data, between 1 and 32. By default the encoder will create a symbol with the minimal number of layers to encode the given data.
options.legacy: Deprecated. The legacy option shows the ISBN-10 above the symbol in place of the ISBN-13. The bars are the same.
options.linkage: Deprecated: For internal use. The linkage option signifies the presence of a GS1 composite 2D component.
options.linkagea: Deprecated: For internal use. The linkagea option specifies that the symbol includes a CC-A or CC-B GS1 composite 2D component.
options.linkagec: Deprecated: For internal use. The linkagec option specifies that the symbol includes a CC-C GS1 composite 2D component.
options.loosespec: Enable best-fit specification mode. The symbol is rendered at its correct physical dimensions when specification data is available. When the specification data is incomplete (e.g. no nominal X-dimension) or the effective X-dimension falls outside specification bounds, the symbol is rendered without error using the best available dimensions.
options.mag: Magnification factor for physical specification mode. Scales the symbol relative to its nominal specification dimensions. Default: 1.0 (100%).
options.mask: The mask option is used to specify the mask pattern, 1 to 4. If unspecified the encoder selects the best mask.
options.mode: The mode option is used to specify how the data is structured in the symbol: * mode=2 - Formatted data containing a Structured Carrier Message with a numeric (US domestic) postal code. * mode=3 - Formatted data containing a Structured Carrier Message with an alphanumeric (international) postal code. * mode=4 - Unstructured extended ASCII data using standard error correction. * mode=5 - Unstructure
options.numeric: Deprecated: Use Telepen Numeric instead. When the numeric option is given, the data is read as either pairs of digits or 0X, 1X, etc. The singular values ^000 to ^015 and ^127 can also be encoded using the parse option.
options.parse: When the parse option is specified, any instances of ^NNN in the data field are replaced with their equivalent ASCII value, useful for specifying unprintable characters.
options.parsefnc: When the parsefnc option is specified, non-data function characters can be specified by escape sequences: * ^FNC1: FNC1. options.permitaddon: When the permitaddon option is provided, the initial seven or eight digits can be followed by a space then two or five digits where a EAN-2 or EAN-5 add-on is required (non-standard).
options.propspec: Enable proportional specification mode. The symbol stays at 1 point per module but bar heights are adjusted to match the specification's height-to-width ratio. The derived height is rounded to a whole number of points so that bars remain pixel-locked at 72 DPI.
options.pzn8: The pzn8 option specifies that a PZN8 symbol is required, in which case the data field must contain seven digits or eight digits.
options.ratio: The ratio option sets the width-to-height ratio of the symbol. The default is 1.5.
options.raw: The raw option denotes that the data field is providing the input as pre-encoded codewords in ^NNN format, suitable for direct low-level encoding.
options.readerinit: The readerinit option denotes that the symbol is used for programming the barcode reader. Reader programming is only compatible with 1- to 22-layer full-range Aztec Code symbols, so layers must also be given, from 1 to 22.
options.rowheight: The rowheight option specifies the height of the bars in each row in modules, from 8 to 50. The default is 8.
options.rowmult: The rowmult option is used to specify how tall each bar is, with respect to the minimum module width. The default is 3.
options.rows: The columns and rows options are used to specify the size of the symbol.
options.sam: The sam option specifies this symbol to be part of multi-part structured data held in up to nine symbols. For example sam=25 specifies this to be the second symbol in a group of five symbols.
options.samid: The sampos, samtotal and samid options make the symbol one of a Structured Append sequence of 2 to 16 symbols, which a reader reassembles into a single message. options.samtotal: The sampos and samtotal options are an alternative to sam that give the position and the total separately, for example sampos=2 samtotal=5. They cannot be combined with sam.
options.segments: The segments option is used to specify the maximum number of segments per row, an even number from 2 to 22. The default is 4.
options.semi: The semi option enables conformance to the SEMI standard by enabling start and stop bars and a check character, which is placed in the second position rather than appended. The data must be 7 to 18 characters.
options.sepheight: The sepheight option specifies the height of the separator bars enclosing the rows in modules, from 1 to 5. The default is 1.
options.shortfinder: The shortfinder option generates a symbol with a shortened finder pattern.
options.showbearer: Display bearer bars above and below the graphical (non-text) components of the symbol, e.g. bar/space array, matrix, composite separator. By default the bearer bars will designate the symbol's quiet zone.
options.showborder: Display a border around the graphical (non-text) components of the symbol, e.g. bar/space array, matrix, composite separator. By default the border (and any background) will designate the symbol's quiet zone.
options.spaceratio: For linear barcodes, scales the width of the spaces that are wider than one module, in the same way as barratio does for bars. A space of n modules is drawn (n - 1) x spaceratio + 1 modules wide. Default: 1.
options.strictspec: Enable strict physical specification mode. The renderer scales the symbol to its correct physical dimensions in millimetres, based on the nominal X-dimension and height from the symbology's specification or selected Application Specification Table (ast).
options.suppresskanjimode: Deprecated: The suppresskanjimode option will prevent the use of Kanji Mode internal encodation. Some readers erroneously consider a Kanji Mode section as an indication that the affected part of the message should be interpreted using a Shift-JIS character set rather than as a data compaction strategy.
options.swidth: The nwidth, wwidth and swidth options can be used to specify a custom width, in modules, for the narrow bars, wide bars and inter-bar spaces respectively. The defaults are 1, 3 and 2.
options.textcolor: Color of the text for a given text group.
options.textdirection: The textNdirection option is used to specify in which direction to orient text for a given text group.
options.textfont: The PostScript font name for a text group.
options.textgaps: The inter-character spacing of a text group.
options.textlinegaps: Specify the gap between consecutive text lines for a text group.
options.textsize: The font size of a text group in points.
options.textsplit: Specify a character by which to split the text content into separate lines.
options.textsubspace: Specify a set of characters that will be replaced with spaces within the text content.
options.textxalign: The textNxalign option is used to specify where to horizontally position the text for a given text group.
options.textxoffset: The horizontal position of the text in points relative to the leftmost bar or modules.
options.textyalign: The textNyalign option is used to specify where to vertically position the text for a given text group.
options.textyoffset: The vertical position of the text in points relative to the base of the bars or modules.
options.type: The mandatory type option is used to specify the size of the symbol, either 7 (24x24), 9 (32x32) or 29 (16x48).
options.unidirectional: The unidirectional option generates a unidirectional Plessey symbol.
options.validatecheck: The validatecheck option takes the last digit of the data to be the check digit and refuses the data if it is wrong.
options.version: The version option is used to specify the size of the symbol, 1 to 40.
options.width: Stretch the symbol to precisely this width, in inches.
options.xdim: Directly specify the X-dimension (narrow bar width or module size) in millimetres. Overrides the nominal value from the AST.
options.xmax: Override the maximum allowed X-dimension in millimetres. Normally provided by the AST.
options.xmin: Override the minimum allowed X-dimension in millimetres. Normally provided by the AST.
options.xnom: Override the nominal X-dimension in millimetres. Normally provided by the Application Specification Table (AST), but can be set by the user.
